scope: Prepared optional descriptors for A-30 support. No 2D scene or default is added; the owned adapter authors its isolated content. Native/resource fixtures supply only a temporary existing-content dataKey for the current shared registry reader. Do not treat that fixture as optional-launcher acceptance.

entries.title: At the Intercom
entries.blurb: Deliver the parcel to unit 12 using the building intercom.

entries.title: At Reception
entries.blurb: Identify the receiver, capture their signature and hand over the parcel at reception.

entries.title: Locker Delivery
entries.blurb: Use the assigned compartment and photograph its closed door.
